implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 138 HDL source files (24 systemverilog, 111 verilog, 3 vhdl) alongside 1 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here.
